mapper.select: SELECT DISPLAY_NAME AS displayName, EMPNO_DISPLAY AS empnoDisplay, DEPTNO AS deptno, PW_HASH AS pwHash FROM ADMIN_PROFILE WHERE ID = 1
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO ADMIN_PROFILE dst USING (SELECT 1 AS ID FROM DUAL) src ON (dst.ID = src.ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET DISPLAY_NAME = #{displayName}, EMPNO_DISPLAY = #{empnoDisplay}, DEPTNO = #{deptno}, PW_HASH = CASE WHEN #{pwHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL THEN #{pwHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ELSE dst.PW_HASH END WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ID, DISPLAY_NAME, EMPNO_DISPLAY, DEPTNO, PW_HASH) VALUES (1, #{displayName}, #{empnoDisplay}, #{deptno}, #{pwHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT pa.EMPNO AS empno, e.ENAME AS ename, TO_CHAR(pa.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM PROXY_ADMIN pa LEFT JOIN EMP e ON e.EMPNO = pa.EMPNO ORDER BY pa.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO PROXY_ADMIN dst USING (SELECT #{empno} AS EMPNO FROM DUAL) src ON (dst.EMPNO = src.EMPNO) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (EMPNO, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{empno}, SYSDATE)
